responsibility: Implements the recursive-descent Go parser that consumes `Lex` tokens and builds the frontend IR in `Gogo`, including declarations, types, expressions, statements, closures, labels, switch/select/for forms, imports, package clauses, and directive validation. It owns token lookahead/unget handling, scope-sensitive name resolution during parsing, syntactic error recovery, and construction of parse-stage statement and expression forms that later lowering passes simplify.
same_name_distinction: Implements the recursive-descent parser methods declared in `parse.h`, driving token consumption from `Lex` and building statements, expressions, declarations, and package/import structure in `Gogo`. Unlike `parse.h`, it is the parsing algorithm and error-recovery code, not the parser class layout and method inventory.
